name: site/hero
title: Hero
summary: The top band of a marketing page: an optional status badge and eyebrow, the page's one serif <h1>, a lead, and at most two pill calls to action, with an optional media region beside (split) or below (stack) the text.

props.name: title
props.description: The page's <h1>, set in the serif display size.

props.name: description
props.description: The lead paragraph under the title.

props.name: primaryCTA
props.type: { text: string; href: string; external?: boolean }
props.description: The primary pill call to action (CtaButton, variant primary). `external` opens it in a new tab.

props.name: secondaryCTA
props.type: { text: string; href: string; external?: boolean }
props.description: The secondary call to action (CtaButton, variant ghost, with a trailing arrow).

props.name: variant
props.description: The band's background: `bg-canvas`, `gradient-hero`, `bg-secondary`, or the `gradient-showcase` wash (which also deepens the bottom padding at lg).

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment of the text column; `center` also centres the lead, the badge and the calls to action.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stack`: one text column, media below. `split`: text beside the `media` slot from lg, stacked (text first) below lg.

props.name: badge
props.description: A short status pill above the headline ("Beta"). It is read as a claim: keep it honest.

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the media region; when set the region is role="group" with this aria-label.

slots.name: media
slots.expects: A demo, screenshot or live widget
slots.description: Rendered beside the text (split) or below it (stack). Absent: no media region.

behaviour: The title is the hero's only <h1>.
With no media, no split layout, no badge and a variant other than showcase, the markup is the 0.1.x template exactly (the legacy branch): no data-layout, no data-slot on the text column.
Otherwise the root carries data-layout, the text column is data-slot="hero-text", the badge is data-slot="hero-badge" and the media region data-slot="hero-media".

The calls to action are CtaButton links (data-slot="button"): the primary is the primary pill, the secondary the ghost pill with an aria-hidden arrow. An external one has target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer".

default.description: The legacy markup: eyebrow, title, lead and both calls to action.

props.subtitle: Nyuchi Africa
props.title: Infrastructure for African builders
props.description: Open tools, open data, built to last.

minimal.description: A title alone, on the gradient.

split.description: The showcase hero: badge, split layout and a labelled media region.

keyboard: Tab reaches the calls to action in order, then anything focusable in the media slot.
focus: Calls to action show the `--ring` focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2) offset from the background.
aria: The media region is role="group" with aria-label only when mediaLabel is given.
The badge dot and the secondary call to action's arrow are aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: The primary call to action, the badge dot and the focus ring follow `--primary` / `--ring`; the gradient-hero and gradient-showcase washes mix `--primary` into the background. Layout never varies by brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Vertical padding steps up at md and lg (py-12, md:py-16, lg:py-20; lg:py-24 for showcase).
The text column is capped (max-w-3xl, max-w-2xl when split); the title balances its lines and the lead is pretty-wrapped.
Split: one column below lg (text first), two columns from lg.
The calls to action wrap onto new lines on a narrow screen.
contract:
contract
  slot is "hero"
  class contains "bg-canvas"
  when centered class contains "bg-secondary"
  when minimal class contains "gradient-hero"
  when split class contains "gradient-showcase"
  when default shows h1 "Infrastructure for African builders"
  when default shows p "Nyuchi Africa"
  when split shows p "Beta"
  a "Get started" min_height 48
  a "Read the docs" min_height 48
  uses button
end

checks.say: The legacy markup carries no data-layout.
The legacy markup has no hero-text column.
Two calls to action, as links.
The primary call to action stays in the tab.
An external call to action opens a new tab safely.
The secondary call to action's arrow is decorative.
A title alone renders no calls to action.
Split is marked on the root.
The badge renders above the title.
A labelled media region is a named group.
The media slot is rendered in the media region.
Stacked media is marked on the root.
An unlabelled media region has no role.
No media slot, no media region.

gaps: The utilities it relies on (`eyebrow`, `gradient-hero`, `gradient-showcase`, `bg-canvas`, `text-display`, `text-body-lg`, `ease-soft`) live in each consuming site's globals.css; the registry does not ship them.
The two branches (legacy 0.1.x and the newer one) duplicate the text column; the legacy branch is kept byte-identical for four sites. A 2.0.0 contract could drop it.
The gradient-showcase wash mixes cobalt as well as `--primary`, so part of the showcase background does not follow the brand overlay.
The calls to action are always links; there is no button form for an in-page action.
